name: Bar-Bar Brute
bio: Bar-Bar Clan bugbear, an undefeated crowd favorite dropped in by Agent. Never retreats, but gets bored of targets out of reach or out of sight.

traits.name: Long-Limbed
traits.desc: Its melee reach is 15 feet with the glaive (5 feet longer than normal), and 10 feet unarmed.

traits.name: Won't Stay Down (1/Day)
traits.desc: When reduced to 0 hit points by anything other than a critical hit, it drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.desc: If it hits a creature that is surprised or hasn't acted yet this combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Two Long Glaive attacks, or two Javelin attacks.
